mod = 10 ** 9 + 7
p, k = [int(x) for x in input().split()]
if k == 0:
    print(pow(p, p - 1, mod))

    print(pow(p, p - 1, mod))
elif k == 1:
    print(pow(p, p, mod))

        x = 1

            yield x
            x = x * k % p
